testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.publish.StaticSiteTests

testcase.name: website forms - validated, spam dropped silently, rate limited, origin checked, editors read and export, viewers cannot()
publishing builds an immutable artifact and the site serves it with strict headers()
custom domains - TXT verification, real TLS probe result, served only for verified public sites, no reserved hosts()
rollback serves an earlier artifact without a rebuild, unpublish takes the site offline, only publishers may do either()
a rendered page containing a script fails the build()
multi-page site - pages, navigation and SEO are validated, every page is in one atomic artifact, directory URLs and 404 work()
a private site needs a member's single-use ticket, then its own session, and access is checked on every request()
